title: Micron and Nvidia are powering a $700 billion chip profit boom: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 美光和英伟达正在推动 7000 亿美元的芯片利润繁荣：每日图表
summary: Chip stocks have shed $2.7 trillion since late June, yet Wall Street still sees industry profits reaching roughly $700 billion in 2027.
summary_zh: 自 6 月底以来，芯片股已蒸发 2.7 万亿美元，但华尔街仍预计 2027 年该行业利润将达到约 7000 亿美元。

title: Google probed by Swiss regulator over Android default search feature
title_zh: 谷歌因 Android 默认搜索功能受到瑞士监管机构调查
summary: Switzerland's Competition Commission (COMCO) has launched a preliminary investigation into Google's removal of a ‌feature that allows mobile phone users to opt out ‌of using its search engine as default, the authority said on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 瑞士竞争委员会 (COMCO) 周二表示，该机构已对谷歌删除一项允许手机用户选择不使用其默认搜索引擎的功能展开初步调查。

title: A hidden pipeline brings Amazon and Walmart to African shoppers
title_zh: 一条隐藏的管道将亚马逊和沃尔玛带给非洲购物者
summary: DAKAR, July 14 (Reuters) - No bank card. Shoppers in Africa increasingly are buying online from big brands such as Amazon or Walmart even though they have no physical presence on much of the continent.
summary_zh: 达喀尔，7 月 14 日（路透社）——没有银行卡。非洲的购物者越来越多地从亚马逊或沃尔玛等大品牌网上购物，尽管这些品牌在非洲大陆的大部分地区没有实体店。

title: China smartphone shipments fall for fifth straight quarter as costs rise - IDC
title_zh: 由于成本上升，中国智能手机出货量连续第五个季度下降 - IDC
summary: China's smartphone shipments fell 4.3% to 66 million ‌units in the second quarter from a year ‌earlier, as many manufacturers hiked prices to reflect rising memory and ​component costs, research firm IDC said on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 研究公司 IDC 周二表示，由于许多制造商提高价格以反映内存和零部件成本上涨，第二季度中国智能手机出货量较去年同期下降 4.3%，至 6600 万部。

title: Huawei, Apple Get Boost in China From Memory Costs, IDC Says
title_zh: IDC 称，华为、苹果在中国市场受益于内存成本
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Huawei Technologies Co. and Apple Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——华为技术有限公司和苹果公司

title: TSMC seen riding AI boom to fifth straight quarter of record profit
title_zh: 台积电有望乘着人工智能热潮，连续第五个季度实现创纪录的利润
summary: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced AI chips, will likely notch a fifth consecutive quarter of record earnings, driven ‌by booming AI infrastructure spending.
summary_zh: 在人工智能基础设施支出蓬勃发展的推动下，全球最大的先进人工智能芯片制造商台积电可能会连续第五个季度实现创纪录的盈利。

title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Sees Fusion Power as Key to AI’s Future
title_zh: 软银的孙正义将聚变能力视为人工智能未来的关键
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SoftBank Group Corp. founder Masayoshi Son said that in the not-so-distant future, nuclear fusion technology will offer the most realistic solution for powering AI data centers’ ballooning needs.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——软银集团创始人孙正义表示，在不远的将来，核聚变技术将为满足人工智能数据中心不断增长的需求提供最现实的解决方案。

title: Huawei's $11 Billion Clean Energy Empire Is Opening New Markets
title_zh: 华为110亿美元的清洁能源帝国正在开拓新市场
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Surrounded by the turquoise waters of the Atlantic and dotted with native fig trees, the archipelago of Fernando de Noronha is one of Brazil’s most coveted tourist destinations.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——费尔南多-迪诺罗尼亚群岛周围环绕着碧绿的大西洋海水，点缀着本土无花果树，是巴西最令人向往的旅游目的地之一。

title: Meta's data center costs are skyrocketing. Here's what you need to know.
title_zh: Meta 的数据中心成本正在飙升。这是您需要了解的内容。
summary: Meta (META) raised the budget for its Louisiana data center from $27 billion to $50 billion. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley takes a closer look at the company's surging costs.
summary_zh: Meta (META) 将其路易斯安那州数据中心的预算从 270 亿美元提高到 500 亿美元。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利（Dan Howley）仔细研究了该公司飙升的成本。
